text: Killing the uvicorn reloader on Windows can orphan its listening socket: main.py runs reload=True and the reloader binds with SO_REUSEADDR, so after a hard kill the socket outlives its PID and a new server binds port 5000 alongside it. Windows then splits connections between the zombie and the new process and the zombie answers with the code it started with, so an edit appears to take effect on some requests only. Detect with netstat -ano | grep ':5000 .*LISTENING' - more than one row is a zombie, and Get-Process on that PID says the process does not exist. Start on a different port to work around it.
